messages:
alex: Heads-up — I opened a small PR to tighten the REST client response shapes for tool-calling (adds optional meta.headers field). Can someone take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/rest-client/pull/992 :eyes:

jamie: What's the compatibility story? breaking change for existing SDK users?

alex: Not breaking if you ignore the new field. It's optional. Changes: server can now include `meta.headers` (map) for routing hints. Example:
```json
{"result": "ok", "meta": {"headers": {"x-source": "beta"}}}
```
We do need to bump minor and add migration note.

taylor: Do we need to change client parsing? current parser assumes top-level `result` only.

alex: Parser updated to be tolerant — PR includes parsing patch in `src/parseResponse.ts`.

kevin: Can you add a unit test that verifies unknown keys don't throw? also add entry to CHANGELOG.

alex: will add tests + changelog. aiming to merge in today's scheduled merge window (4pm PST). @maria can you review for API surface and docs? :pray:

maria: I can skim after lunch (ETA 1:30pm). If it's purely additive I'm ok to approve. Please add migration blurb in docs.

jamie: quick ask — does this affect streaming client behavior? tool-calls over streams still work?

alex: streaming unaffected — this is REST response-only. I added a note in PR description.

pr-bot: CI passed — 37 tests, 0 failures. coverage decreased 0.02% (non-blocking).

kevin: LGTM once tests + changelog. Alex, tag me when ready and I'll approve.

alex: added tests + CHANGELOG entry, pushed. PTAL @kevin @maria

maria: reviewed, left two small docs nits. none blocking. :+1:

kevin: approved. merging in 10m unless anyone objects.

jamie: no objections. thx.

alex: merging now. deploy-bot will handle rollout. :rocket:
